name: @equin/plugin-reports-outbox-file
description: Writing a report into the report outbox, for a process with no server (a CLI run, a supervised child, a backend before it is ready): fileReportFromProcess / fileReportFromProcessSync, the entry format the drain reads, and the outbox's data-dir declaration. Core-only and light, so a writer bundles the writer and never the drain (reports/outbox's server, which reaches the reports engine).
